text:
alex: heads-up, after the role-schema-v2 rollout we started seeing a handful of unexpected denies for support tools. logs look like: `perm_check(user_id, action) -> DENY (missing role_version)`
priya: ugh, saw the same. noticed service accounts for analytics couldn't read some metrics buckets — 403 from S3 IAM proxy.
dana: is this the backfill that ran last night? deploy-bot: migration-backfill-job finished with exit=0, shards 0-63 completed.
ops-sre: timerange correlation shows the first failures at 02:14 UTC, which matches the migration window.
alex: backfill query we ran was: ```sql
UPDATE principals SET roles = coalesce(roles, default_roles_v2) WHERE roles IS NULL;
```
alex: but some rows on shard 27 still returned NULL on a quick check.
priya: I ran `SELECT count(*) FROM principals WHERE roles IS NULL AND shard = 27;` and got 142. shouldn't be any.
mike: possible race with the write path? rollout had a brief canary where old services were still writing schema_v1 fields.
irene: also noticed KMS wrapped keys for a couple service accounts showing "not found" in audit logs. could be principal id format changed so KMS lookup failed.
dana: ok action plan: 1) freeze further schema-rollout toggles 2) re-run deterministic backfill for missing shards 3) add a quick integrity check and abort if any NULLs remain 4) confirm KMS principal mapping.
ops-sre: I'm attaching the ad-hoc script I used to scan shards: ```bash
for s in {0..63}; do psql -c "SELECT count(*) FROM principals WHERE roles IS NULL AND shard=$s"; done
```
priya: +1 for integrity gate. can we ship a lightweight migration-checker that runs before cutover?
alex: yes, I'll draft a PR for a preflight that checks shard zeroes and KMS mappings.
security-bot: ALERT: 7 denied requests matched new deny rule since rollout. Details logged to /var/logs/perm-audit/3031112222.log
mike: can we temporarily route denies to debug-allow for non-production tenants while we triage? want to avoid more alarms.
dana: we can but must log loudly and revert after. ops-sre any objections?
ops-sre: fine for staging/dev only. not prod. we'll create a canary tag.
irene: one more note: audit logging shows a mismatch between principal.email and principal.kms_identity for some federated SAs — probably from name normalization. I'll produce a mapping table.
alex: ok owners: alex/priya for backfill & integrity gate, dana/ops-sre for rollout freeze and canary tag, irene for KMS identity mapping, mike for short-lived debug allow policy. target: triage done by EOD UTC.
priya: ping if you need additional logs. I'll gather failed request IDs for the team. :mag:
alex: thanks all, will update thread with PR link and backfill run id. :thumbsup:
